title: Orsù, spicciati presto
subtitle: Don Giovanni and Leporello: recitative from Don Giovanni, Act 1

passages.label: Orsù, spicciati presto … la vita che menate è da briccone!
Temerario, in tal guisa! … per porla in lista!
Va là, che sei il grand' uom! … Già prese foco! (to the end)

licences.source: W. A. Mozart, Don Giovanni, K. 527 (1787), Act 1 scene 4, recitative before No. 3
licences.author: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart (1756–1791)

licences.notes: Words as printed in the Schirmer vocal score (Siamo soli?, Dunque quand'è così, Non, ne sò nulla, sò, perchè, grand' uom, Leporello's asides in brackets).

licences.source: G. Schirmer vocal score, New York 1900 (plate 15147, IMSLP #68957), pages 30–32, bars 1–38 of the recitative before No. 3
licences.author: G. Schirmer, piano reduction as printed
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: the sung lines and the piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, then checked bar by bar and checked again by a fresh checker. The English singing translation and the stage directions are left out. Secco recitative: a single bass staff is printed for the keyboard, written here as the piano's left hand. Kept as printed: the bass E in bar 35 has no flat (probably meant as E flat). Playback tempo: free, as recitative is sung, played at a speaking pace, ♩ = 104, about 1½ minutes, from the median of five complete recordings (Fricsay 1958, Giulini 1959, Böhm 1977, Haitink 1984, Karajan 1985: 1:22, 1:14, 1:32, 1:28, 1:37; median 1:28).
